comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: Staging shows reassignment visible in search within 2s. Watching production lag metrics next.

content.text: Staging shows reassignment visible in search within 2s. Watching production lag metrics next.
REST search continues to return the previous assignee for ~45 seconds after an issue is reassigned. Filters on the new assignee miss the issue; filters on the old one still hit it.

Expected: search reflects reassignment by the time the update API returns 200, or within the documented near-real-time window of a few seconds. Actual: the search index document keeps the stale assignee until a 45-second refresh cycle, and the update path does not trigger an eager reindex.

Hypothesis: issue update publishes to the search indexer over a debounced queue with maxWaitMs=45000, and assignee-only patches are classified as low priority so they always wait for maxWait rather than flushing early.
Agents sorting queues by assignee see ghost work and miss newly assigned tickets during that window.
